name: DropCols
description: Drop the columns matching any of the provided selectors (blacklist by column name).
usage: Provide at least one of ``columns`` (exact names), ``pattern`` (glob), ``regex``, ``startswith`` or ``endswith``. Matches from every selector are unioned and removed. Exact names in ``columns`` that are not present are silently ignored.

attributes.name: columns
attributes.description: Exact column names to drop. Missing columns are silently ignored.

attributes.name: pattern
attributes.description: Glob/fnmatch pattern to match column names (e.g. "debug_*").

attributes.name: regex
attributes.description: Regular expression to match column names (e.g. "^tmp_.*$").

attributes.name: startswith
attributes.description: Drop columns whose name starts with any of these prefixes.

attributes.name: endswith
attributes.description: Drop columns whose name ends with any of these suffixes.

json_schema.title: DropCols

pattern.description: Glob/fnmatch pattern to match column names (e.g. "debug_*").

regex.description: Regular expression to match column names (e.g. "^tmp_.*$").

startswith.description: Prefixes; columns starting with any are dropped.

endswith.description: Suffixes; columns ending with any are dropped.

json_schema.description: Drop columns matching any selector. At least one selector is required.
